thread:
ana: Heads-up: we're targeting a short safety cordon for search-index-v2 deploy tonight (Wed 2025-05-14) 02:30-03:30 UTC. Not a full freeze but no non-urgent infra changes. Please ack if you can be on standby. @devon @ravi

devon: Ack. CI artifacts validated, canary image pushed. Cache invalidation job queued for post-rollout.

ravi: QA ack 00% on smoke. Will run expanded regression right after canary.

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled cordon window created: window_id=wnd-20250514-0230, owners=[ana,devon]. Notifications sent to infra and support.

ana: (typo) ana: ignore previous.

ana: Just kidding.

ana: Sorry, accidental.

ana: Back to thread.

ana: Plan summary: pin current prod -> search/v2.4.0, then progressive rollout 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m holds between major jumps. Health gates: index_error_rate, doc_latency_p95, write_fails. Manual stop: sustained write_fails >0.5% or any index_error_rate spike >1%.

devon: Pin command queued: /pin search/v2.4.0 -> dedicated-search.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin applied. pin_ref=pin-20250514-xyz

product-lead: Noting the "no-ui-change" freeze tag. PM confirmed release notes published: https://redwood.internal/changelogs/search-index-v2.4.0

ravi: Oncall passed runbook sanity. Incident hooks ready.

oncall: oncall: Pager set to loud. If rollback needed call /deploy revert canary-6184000000 or @oncall. Quick rollback script at ops/tools/revert_search.sh

ana: (again accidental name) ana: Please don't run DB migrations during cordon. We have a lightweight index migration but it's online-only.

devon: Canary started: cohort=search-canary-6184000000; tracing enabled; metric snapshot in ~3m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started at 1%. canary_id=canary-6184000000

ops-bot: ops-bot: auto-checklist: backups verified, read-replicas healthy, disk<70% on nodes.

ravi: First metric pulse: doc_latency_p95 +8% (ok), write_fails 0.12% (ok), index_error_rate 0.2% (ok).

ana: QA running query regressions. If we see pattern of 503s on queries with filter=geo, notify immediately.

devon: Noted. Adding a temporary monitor: monitor add query_503_geo threshold=3m:count>3

ops-bot: ops-bot: monitor created: query_503_geo id=mon-9001

ravi: QA found two geo-query 503s in the first 10m. Investigating routing layer.

devon: Rolling restart of search-proxy on canary cohort to rule out sticky sessions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary metrics update: write_fails fell to 0.05%, index_error_rate steady.

ana: If 503s exceed manual stop rule (/manual-stop threshold: >5 503s in 5m), we revert to previous pin: /pin search/v2.3.8 -> dedicated-search

oncall: oncall: Preparing revert playbook. Will coordinate with infra if needed.

product-lead: Support channel prepped with canned message. We'll send an update if rollback occurs.

devon: Proceeding to 5% now per plan.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling to 5%. snapshot will follow.

ravi: 5% snapshot: doc_latency_p95 +10% (ok), index_error_rate 0.25% (ok), query_503_geo 1 event in last 5m.

ana: Since metrics are healthy and QA passed expanded checks, I'll schedule the 25% jump in 15m. If anything odd before that, stop and ping.

ops-bot: ops-bot: cordon reminder to infra at 02:45 UTC.

devon: quick note: dedicated-search has ~12% spare capacity across regions; auto-burst policy allows cross-pool for up to 10m in case of transient load.

ravi: Small note: a legacy client uses exact doc ids for embeddings; we flagged potential embedding drift in the release notes. Support notified.

devon: canary metrics stable. moving to 25% now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling to 25% (canary-6184000000).

ravi: At 25% we saw a brief spike: doc_latency_p95 +42% for ~90s, correlated with GC on a single node. Autoscaler removed node and replaced; overall errors stayed within gate.

ana: Gate rule: if p95 > +50% sustained over 2m -> rollback. This was transient, ok to continue.

product-lead: Reminder: freeze lift target 03:30 UTC if we hit 100% and no rollback.

oncall: oncall: I'll stay until the cordon ends. If any step requires immediate revert, ping pager.

devon: 100% roll will be manual after final thumbs-up from QA and SRE.

ravi: Expanded regression pass complete. No blocking issues.

ana: Final checklist before 100%:
- confirm pin still points to search/v2.4.0
- run one last canary query sweep
- notify support and schedule brief status post

devon: All confirmed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: final canary snapshot: p95 +6%, write_fails 0.07%, index_error_rate 0.15%. No gate breaches.

ana: Proceeding to 100% rollout now. Keep this thread for audit. If you leave, handoff to @oncall. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
